Package de.hof.dms.service

Class PermissionService

java.lang.Object
de.hof.dms.service.PermissionService
@Service @Profile("!no-mongo") public class PermissionService extends Object
Central RBAC resolver. Decides whether a user may perform an action on a document or folder following the architecture permission model:
  1. dms_admin → always allow
  2. resource owner → allow all actions
  3. dms_department_manager whose department matches the resource → allow all actions
  4. direct ACL membership (user id / role / department) gated by the ACL's access flags
  5. inherited ACL from the parent folder chain when inheritFromParent = true
  6. dms_contributor may CREATE inside any folder it can READ
  7. otherwise → deny

    • canDocument

      public boolean canDocument(CurrentUser user, DocumentRecord doc, PermissionService.Action action)
      Resolves whether the user may perform action on a document, evaluating the document's own ACL first and then, when it inherits, the parent folder chain. Admins are always allowed.
      Returns:
      true if the action is permitted

    • canFolder

      public boolean canFolder(CurrentUser user, Folder folder, PermissionService.Action action)
      Resolves whether the user may perform action on a folder, walking the folder's inheritance chain. Admins are always allowed, and a dms_contributor may CREATE within any folder it can READ.
      Returns:
      true if the action is permitted
